text: U.S. stocks were mixed on Monday as investors navigated geopolitical tensions surrounding potential U.S. sanctions against Iran and ongoing trade concerns, while preparing for a week of high-stakes earnings and the Jackson Hole Economic Symposium. While the Dow Jones Industrial Average saw modest gains, the Nasdaq and S&P 500 faced downward pressure, with communication services and financials leading the market while technology, energy, and industrial sectors lagged. This volatility in the technology sector was driven by investor caution ahead of upcoming earnings from major chipmakers like Nvidia, alongside broader concerns regarding the sustainability of artificial intelligence valuations.
